name: slack-rss-notifier
description: Monitor gadget and tech RSS feeds on Cloudflare Workers and deliver new items to a personal Slack DM.

interface.shortDescription: Send gadget news RSS updates to a personal Slack DM.
interface.longDescription: Scaffold and operate a Cloudflare Worker that polls gadget and tech RSS feeds on a cron schedule, deduplicates items with KV, and posts new articles to a Slack DM using a bot token.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up Slack RSS Notifier for gadget news and send new articles to my Slack DM.
